jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - AI/ML
jobs.location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States; Remote; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
Company Description

Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

Job Description

We are seeking a customer-obsessed product manager to drive the development and integration of AI/ML capabilities within Air Enterprise Readiness platform. This is an individual contributor role responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering AI/ML solutions that enhance our Applications and transform how current and future users make critical decisions.

As the AI/ML Product Manager, you will own the AI/ML roadmap and therefore be accountable for identifying opportunities where artificial intelligence and machine learning can deliver meaningful value to our customers, translating complex technical capabilities into user-friendly solutions, and ensuring the successful integration of our models and algorithms into Air Enterprise Readiness platform.  You will need to think strategically about how to position Air as a leader in Defense AI, identify competitive advantages and market opportunities through AI/ML capabilities, and drive strategic decisions about how AI/ML innovations differentiate Air in the marketplace.  You will partner with data scientists, ML engineers, application-aligned PMs, and our engagement teams to identify high-impact use cases, define requirements for ML-powered features, and ensure seamless delivery of intelligent capabilities that scale across our customer base. In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI/ML research and practical defense acquisition applications.

In order to do this job well, you must possess a moderate technical understanding of AI/ML methodologies and emerging technology combined with exceptional product judgment to identify opportunities where AI/ML can deliver measurable customer value. You must work effectively cross-functionally in often ambiguous circumstances, translating complex technical capabilities into clear product requirements and articulating the value of AI/ML solutions both internally and externally to non-technical stakeholders.

In a typical week, an AI/ML product manager could expect to:

- Spend time on site with users, seeking to understand their pain points and triangulate the commonalities where AI/ML can automate manual processes, enhance decision-making, or provide predictive insights

- Write detailed product requirements documents (PRDs) and user stories for AI/ML features

- Collaborate with data science and AI/ML engineering teams to assess the feasibility of proposed solutions

- Partner with designers and Application PMs to integrate AI/ML capabilities seamlessly into existing Air workflows, ensuring models enhance rather than disrupt user experiences

- Work with the sales team to articulate the value proposition of AI/ML features to prospective customers and understand market demand for intelligent automation

- Define success metrics for AI/ML initiatives

Scope of Responsibilities

- Define and communicate the AI/ML product strategy and roadmap aligned with Air's positioning, mission, and customer needs

- Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities where AI/ML can transform user workflows

- Validate concepts using the value proposition canvas/business model canvas, build a comprehensive business case, and communicate and defend the prioritization internally

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform AI/ML product positioning

- Partner with data science, AI/ML, and software engineering teams to scope the expected associated investment costs/timelines, and ensure that the business can deliver on

- Facilitate market introduction of new features/functions while balancing tradeoffs of risk, cost, and speed

- Ensure smooth integration of prototyped features/functions into Air for utilization across customer accounts

This is a full-time team member position, working in one of our offices at our Arlington, VA, Pittsburgh, PA, or San Francisco, CA locations.

This role may require up to 40% travel

Qualifications

- U.S. Citizenship is required

Required Skills:

- 5+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML products or data-driven solutions

- Experience with ML development lifecycle, including data preparation, model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring

- Proven track record of successfully launching AI/ML products or features in production environments

- Strong value orientation, understanding of what matters for our customers, and why

- Self-starter, owner mentality

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment

- Exceptional written and oral communication skills across all levels of the business

- Bachelor’s degree in business or a technology-related field

Desired Skills:

- Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship

- Experience in or exposure to the nuances of a startup or other entrepreneurial environment

- Experience in or around the DoW

- Full product lifecycle experience, from early idea through production and maintenance

- Familiarity with the value proposition canvas and/or business model canvas frameworks

- Advanced degree in a business or technical field

- We firmly believe that past performance is the best indicator of future performance.  If you thrive while building solutions to complex problems, are a self-starter, and are passionate about making an impact in global security, we’re eager to hear from you.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Builder Experiences
jobs.location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States
jobs.description:
Company Description

Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced product manager to build a strategy and execute against a roadmap to mature our low-code / no code builder experiences. You will be responsible for prioritizing, rationalizing, and integrating existing prototypes into the platform as well as developing new platform capabilities that serve our customers at scale.  This is an individual contributor reporting to the SVP of Product.

You are responsible for thinking broadly across the communities we serve and delivering solutions that provide value to a wide range of customers. You’ll partner with other PMs and our engagement and implementation teams to scale “in-the-field” solutions and improve the configurability and adaptability of our platform. You should be highly motivated by striking a balance between building solutions that are robust and scalable and meeting customer needs.

In order to do this job well, you must possess exceptional judgment when it comes to identifying opportunities to deliver customer value in a productized way, as well as in the relative prioritization of those opportunities. You must work effectively cross-functionally in often ambiguous circumstances, distilling market opportunities to a clear set of objectives and solutions, and articulating the value of those solutions both internally and externally.

In a typical week, you could expect to:

- Spend several days on site with users (internal and external), seeking to understand how users across a variety of accounts utilize Air Enterprise Readiness platform to relieve pain points and triangulate the commonalities to build new, valuable workflows in the Air Enterprise Readiness platform.

- Draft clear and compelling articulation of customer problems, and what a good solution to those problems would look like in the Air Enterprise Readiness platform.

- Partner with the other PMs and go-to-market team to help assess opportunities and understand the degree to which customer requirements align with product capabilities and roadmap

- Define how those solutions deliver value across a wide range of customer environments and determine what features are necessary to support broad adoption of the solution.

- Collaborate with engineering and design teams to deliver the most promising capabilities.

- Do competitive analysis to understand what the table stakes capabilities are and what differentiators.

This is a full-time team member position, working in our offices at our Arlington, VA or Pittsburgh, PA locations.

This role may require up to 50% travel

Scope of Responsibilities

- Define and prioritize the builder roadmap, balancing technical debt with high-impact UI improvements

- Act as the "Internal PM" for our customer teams, ensuring they have the platform tools (APIs, UI components) they need to build faster

- Spend time with power users to understand where the UI creates "friction" and translate those pains into elegant functional requirements

- Partner with internal engineering, AI, and data science teams to scope the expected associated investment costs/timelines, and ensure that the business can deliver on scope, contractual obligations, and agreed-upon timelines

- Facilitate market introduction of new features/functions while balancing tradeoffs of risk, cost, and speed

- Ensure smooth integration of prototyped features/functions into Air Enterprise Readiness platform for utilization across customer accounts

Qualifications

- U.S. Citizenship is required

Required Skills:

- 5+ years of PM experience, specifically in B2B SaaS, ERPs, or highly configurable specialized industry platforms (e.g., FinTech, HealthTech, Construction Tech) platforms

- Fluency in backend systems concepts, including authentication/authorization models, data schemas, data orchestration systems, service contracts, and distributed system tradeoffs

- Expert in SQL and familiarity with Python and GitLab/GitHub

- Experience in shipping infrastructure or platform services

- Fluency with technical concepts (microservices, distributed systems, caching, permissions models, data schemas, event systems, etc.)

- Familiarity with LLM-based systems and the tradeoffs between deterministic workflows and agentic systems

- Strong information architecture instincts, especially in configurable enterprise environments

- Strong value orientation, understanding of what matters for our customers, and why

- Self-starter, owner mentality

- You have a growth mindset and have worked in a startup or growth-stage environment where you’ve had to build processes from scratch, not just follow existing ones.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment

- Exceptional written and oral communication skills across all levels of the business

- Bachelor’s degree in business or a technology-related field

Desired Skills:

- Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship

- Experience in or around DoD

- Experience working on low/no-code workflow or application builders

We are seeking a visionary Vice President of Product Marketing to define and execute the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Air Enterprise Readiness platform and AI-enabled applications. This leader will be responsible for market positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and driving product adoption within the national security community and branches of the military.

In order to do this job well a candidate must possess deep experience in B2B enterprise software/SaaS marketing, exceptional communication and leadership skills, and a strong understanding of the U.S. Defense/Federal market and procurement process.

This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Arlington, VA

This role may require up to 15% travel.

- Define and articulate the company's product narratives, value propositions, and market positioning to internal and external audiences.

- Lead and execute GTM strategies for new product launches, feature releases, and market expansion.

- Develop comprehensive sales enablement materials, including competitive analysis, battle cards, and presentations for the Air's sales team.

- Serve as the expert on the Defense Acquisition market, customer segments, and competitor landscape to inform product roadmap and marketing campaigns.

- U.S. Citizenship is required

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Marketing, with at least 3 years in a leadership role (Director/VP) at a B2B enterprise software or SaaS company
